description: This file defines a SettingsActivity and a SettingsFragment for the Android app's settings screen. The activity hosts a fragment that loads preferences from an XML resource and includes logic to handle theme changes via preferences.

classes.name: SettingsActivity
classes.description: An activity that hosts the settings fragment and manages the settings UI, including navigation support.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A fragment that loads preferences from XML and handles theme change interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and replaces the container with the SettingsFragment.

methods.name: onSupportNavigateUp
methods.description: Handles navigation when the up button is pressed.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from resource and sets change listener for the theme preference.
